# VoKoo health schemas and tools

This is first-party VoKoo source imported from an owner-controlled repository
at commit `8ae915498bd6175013032f8152b40599ced67150` on 5 September 2026.

Included:

- canonical health JSON schemas, examples, specification, and validator;
- Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Java model implementations;
- archived health-data tools and their source.

Generated build products, repository metadata, the redundant incompatible Go
aggregate (`language/go/models.go`), and the former standalone license files
are intentionally excluded. This source is governed by VoKoo's root license.
